edits.content:
-- Metric 4 headline: PRs opened on release day against the Thursday before, in percent, one
-- row per release day. It carries its breakdown: `breakdown` spells out every activity's
-- change (PRs opened, PRs merged, commits), so the headline is never read without it.
select
    cast(release_day as varchar) as release_day_key,
    min(release_day) as release_day,
    min(baseline_start) as baseline_start,
    min(baseline_end) as baseline_end,
    min(baseline_weeks) as baseline_weeks,
    count(*) as activities_total,
    count(pct_change) as activities_available,
    max(pct_change) filter (where activity = 'prs_opened') as github_release_day_change,
    string_agg(
        activity_label || ' ' || coalesce(printf('%+.1f%%', pct_change), 'not yet available'),
        ' · ' order by activity desc
    ) as breakdown
from {{ ref('fct_github_release_day_activities') }}
group by release_day

version: 2
models:
- name: fct_github_release_day
  description: 'Metric 4 headline: PRs opened on release day against the Thursday before, one row per
    release day, with its breakdown.'
  config:
    meta:
      dex:
        grain:
        - release_day_key
        population:
          rule: One row for the configured release day (var github_release_day).
        assumptions:
        - decision: What the headline is
          chosen: PRs opened's release-day change (no longer the average of the three)
          evidence: request
          column: github_release_day_change
          detail: 'user, 20 Nov: no average, just a headline; PRs opened is the biggest number, use that
            one'
        - decision: Another activity not yet available
          chosen: headline still shown; the breakdown says which is missing
          evidence: request
          column: github_release_day_change
          detail: the headline reads only PRs opened
  columns:
  - name: release_day_key
    description: 'Release day as text: the row''s key.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: key
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: release_day
    description: GTA 6's release day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: time
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: baseline_start
    description: First baseline day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: baseline_end
    description: Last baseline day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: baseline_weeks
    description: Baseline days (same weekday, weeks before).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: activities_total
    description: Activities in the breakdown.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: never
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: count
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: activities_available
    description: Activities with a change.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: never
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: count
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: github_release_day_change
    description: PRs opened's release-day change, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: NULL until PRs opened has a change.
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: percent
  - name: breakdown
    description: Every activity's change. Always report it with the headline.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
unit_tests:
- name: github_headline_is_prs_opened
  description: The headline is PRs opened's change, not an average; the breakdown spells out every activity.
  model: fct_github_release_day
  given:
  - input: ref('fct_github_release_day_activities')
    rows:
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      release_day: '2026-11-19'
      baseline_start: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_end: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_weeks: 1
      pct_change: -10.0
    - activity: prs_merged
      activity_label: PRs merged
      release_day: '2026-11-19'
      baseline_start: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_end: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_weeks: 1
      pct_change: -5.0
    - activity: commits
      activity_label: Commits
      release_day: '2026-11-19'
      baseline_start: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_end: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_weeks: 1
      pct_change: 3.0
  expect:
    rows:
    - release_day_key: '2026-11-19'
      activities_total: 3
      activities_available: 3
      github_release_day_change: -10.0
      breakdown: PRs opened -10.0% · PRs merged -5.0% · Commits +3.0%
- name: github_headline_stands_when_another_activity_is_missing
  description: A missing commit count does not hide the PRs opened headline.
  model: fct_github_release_day
  given:
  - input: ref('fct_github_release_day_activities')
    rows:
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      release_day: '2026-11-19'
      baseline_start: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_end: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_weeks: 1
      pct_change: -10.0
    - activity: commits
      activity_label: Commits
      release_day: '2026-11-19'
      baseline_start: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_end: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_weeks: 1
      pct_change: null
  expect:
    rows:
    - activities_available: 1
      github_release_day_change: -10.0
      breakdown: PRs opened -10.0% · Commits not yet available
- name: github_headline_null_until_prs_opened_counted
  description: Before PRs opened is counted the headline is NULL, whatever else is in.
  model: fct_github_release_day
  given:
  - input: ref('fct_github_release_day_activities')
    rows:
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      release_day: '2026-11-19'
      baseline_start: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_end: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_weeks: 1
      pct_change: null
    - activity: commits
      activity_label: Commits
      release_day: '2026-11-19'
      baseline_start: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_end: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_weeks: 1
      pct_change: 3.0
  expect:
    rows:
    - github_release_day_change: null

-- The GitHub release-day headline never travels without its breakdown.
select *
from {{ ref('fct_github_release_day') }}
where github_release_day_change is not null
    and breakdown is null
